justification: Removes 12 live typed rule figures (ADG storey counts, user-guide 8.5 m, CDC 60 m2 label, bushfire 10/50 distances, flood 1% AEP, a 500 m station line), labels the developers sample as illustrative, deletes 3 unused files and 3 unread constants, and notes the 3 m height guard is a data check.

pre_impl.existing_data: What existing data/state does this interact with? [table/column or 'none']
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: What if existing data doesn't match assumptions? [specific failure]
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Will this apply to existing rows or only new? [mechanism]
pre_impl.external_source_error: (Critical only) What does external source return on error?
pre_impl.frontend_type: (Critical only) Does frontend type need updating?
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: (Critical only) What does user see if this fails?

functions.name: parseADGSeparationText
functions.input: ADG 3F-1 requirement text read from sepp_adg_requirements
functions.output: height band rows labelled by height only, no typed storey counts
functions.if_none: unparsed text gives no rows; the card says it could not be read

break_it.scenario: a reader takes the ADG storey count as a rule for their building
break_it.what_happens: storeys are not the ADG test, height is
break_it.how: labels show the height band only

break_it.scenario: a deleted component is still imported somewhere in the app
break_it.how: grep showed no importer outside backups; ComplianceDashboard kept because a type is imported

break_it.scenario: a test still asserts a removed constant exists
break_it.what_happens: jest fails in CI and blocks merging
break_it.how: that single assertion removed with the constants

post_merge.manual_verify: open /user-guide, a flood council page and the bushfire report landing page

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a live typed figure is unlisted or the open count rises
